sections.heading: Sudden starts
sections.body:
- *echarse a* + infinitive — to suddenly start (laughing, crying, running, trembling): *Se echó a reír.* *Echó a correr.*
- *romper a* + infinitive — to burst out (mainly *llorar, reír, hablar, llover*): *Rompió a llorar.* *Rompió a llover.* (It started pouring.)
- *ponerse a* + infinitive — to start (neutral, everyday): *Me puse a estudiar.*
- *soltarse a* + infinitive — to start (letting go): *El bebé se soltó a caminar.* (the baby started walking — Mexico)

sections.heading: Endings and outcomes
sections.body:
- *acabar por* + infinitive = *acabar* + gerund — to end up: *Acabó por aceptar.* = *Acabó aceptando.*
- *terminar de* + infinitive — to finish: *No termino de entenderlo.* (I just don't quite get it.)
- *llegar a* + infinitive — to go so far as: *Llegó a amenazarme.* (He even threatened me.)
- *venir* + gerund — to have been doing (over time, with insistence): *Vengo diciéndotelo desde hace meses.* (I've been telling you for months.)
- *quedar en* + infinitive — to agree to: *Quedamos en vernos el lunes.*
- *dar por* + participle — to consider: *Lo dieron por muerto.* (They gave him up for dead.) *Dar por hecho / sentado* (to take for granted): *No lo des por sentado.*
- *dar con* — to find, hit upon: *Por fin di con la solución.*

examples: Echó a correr cuando vio al perro.
He started running when he saw the dog.
Me puse a estudiar después de cenar.
He ended up accepting the offer.
I just don't quite get it.
He even went so far as to threaten me.
I've been telling you for months.
We agreed to meet on Monday.
They gave him up for dead.
Por fin di con la solución.
Se echó a temblar de miedo.
I take it for granted that you'll come.
